armed.name: kind-1 slot +0    OWNER

armed.name: the rest of the derived window
armed.why: covers every position the slot array could occupy if the 64-byte alignment step were wrong; an emission OUTSIDE 0xd486ec-0xd486fb would REFUTE the Mission-1 address and name the true one

armed.why: E27 named 0xd48744 as outside every E24 tier; this closes that blind spot

armed.name: the SECOND MPCh chunk header
armed.expect_last_value: 0x0100381c at 0xd49b18, stored pre-feed at boot-log line 22354 in e26a
armed.why: already inside E24/E26 past-end extension tier 0xd49af4-0xd49b73; carried unchanged

rows.claim: the kind-1 queue head reads 0xd49b14 with a byte count >= 14,364 from the feed onward and NEVER changes to end of run
rows.observable: YES -- both fields receive guest stores, so diagWatchEmit sees them
rows.confirm: the LAST pre-park store to 0xd486f8 carries value 0xd49b14 AND the last pre-park store to 0xd486f4 carries a value >= 14364 AND there are ZERO stores to either address after the park
rows.refute: the last store to 0xd486f8 is not 0xd49b14, or the last store to 0xd486f4 is < 14364, or EITHER address is stored to after the park
rows.unobservable_if: no emission ever lands anywhere in 0xd486e0-0xd4873f (then the derived address is wrong)

rows.observable: PARTLY -- E26's named limit binds. diagWatchEmit fires on GUEST STORES ONLY, so the at-park VALUE of an address nothing writes is not readable with the existing instruments: no store, no emission, no value. What IS observable is that the value does not CHANGE by any guest store after it is set.
rows.confirm: a store of 0x0100381c at 0xd49b18 from pc=0x3dff8c pre-feed, and ZERO stores to 0xd49b18 thereafter -- i.e. the value is unchanged by any guest store
rows.refute: any later store to 0xd49b18, or no 0x0100381c store at all
rows.unobservable_as_designed: the at-park READ of 0xd49b18 is NOT obtainable: the instrument is store-triggered. E28 reports the change-half and marks the value-half unobservable rather than inferring it. The residual is host CD DMA, which E26 already showed writes this buffer without emitting -- bounded here by there being no further sceCdRead into it, which the boot log counts.

rows.claim: ZERO guest stores to 0xd49b14 / 0xd49b18 after the feed
rows.observable: YES -- exactly what a store-triggered instrument measures
rows.confirm: zero [diag:watch] emissions at either address on any line after the feed line
rows.refute: one or more emissions at either address after the feed

rows.claim: [MPEG:GetPicture] x1 and [MPEG:feedES] x1 in the new boot log
rows.observable: YES -- host-side counters already compiled in, capped at 32 so 1 is a true count

named_limit: E26: diagWatchEmit fires on GUEST STORES ONLY. Every row above is graded on stores. A row whose at-park VALUE has no store behind it is reported unobservable-as-designed WITH its reason, and its observable half stands.
scope: P1-P4 and the carried controls ONLY. This lane is a confirmation, not a fishing trip.
